python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import json
import os

adc_path = os.path.expanduser('~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json')
with open(adc_path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Request access token with scopes including spreadsheets
params = {
    'client_id': data['client_id'],
    'client_secret': data['client_secret'],
    'refresh_token': data['refresh_token'],
    'grant_type': 'refresh_token'
}

import urllib.parse
req_data = urllib.parse.urlencode(params).encode('utf-8')
req = urllib.request.Request('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', data=req_data, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        res_json = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
        access_token = res_json.get('access_token')
        print('Got token successfully:', access_token[:15])
        
        # Test updating / writing to the spreadsheet via Sheets API v4
        sheet_id = '1aFB2O37w-Dh0RmN_W2CultjS1X4Vb7LqxbKMb99UVp4'
        # Let's get sheet metadata first
        meta_url = f'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/{sheet_id}'
        meta_req = urllib.request.Request(meta_url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {access_token}'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(meta_req) as meta_resp:
            meta = json.loads(meta_resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            print('Spreadsheet title:', meta.get('properties', {}).get('title'))
            for s in meta.get('sheets', []):
                print('Sheet:', s['properties']['title'], 'ID:', s['properties']['sheetId'])
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', e)
"
